title: The localization of a projective module is projective
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset and $P$ a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then the localization $S^{-1}P$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is a projective $S^{-1}R$-module.
